versions.content: Relation of Controller Application to SPN It is technically pos- sible that several Controller Applications , formally represented by the meta-class Di- agnosticJ1939Node , can send the same Suspect Parameter Number . In response to this specific characteristic of the J1939 approach, the multiplicity of the reference DiagnosticJ1939SpnMapping . sendingNode has been set to 0..*.
